title: Warm-Up and Injury Reduction (WHO)
summary: Evidence-based warm-up guidance to reduce injury risk and improve readiness through progressive intensity, movement preparation, and sport-specific activation.
recommendations: Ramp heart rate gradually for 3''5 minutes
Rehearse movement patterns before high load (squat/hinge/jump)
Finish with sport-specific build-ups (2''3 short reps)

ai_signals.notes: Warm-up reduces injury risk and improves readiness.
Mobility supports safe movement under load.
Control during dynamic moves reduces injury risk.
